control_failures.control_label: guarding, clearance and misfire handling for a blast
receipt, magazining and reconciliation of explosives

facts.hazard_release: fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation
facts.title: preventive action - alarm philosophy conformance on P-8302

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 1 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control BLAST_GUARDING_AND_CLEARANCE: the guarding, clearance and misfire handling for a blast was in place but did not perform, and the learning team review classified this as an individual or team action.
Control EXPLOSIVES_RECONCILIATION: the receipt, magazining and reconciliation of explosives was in place but did not perform, and the learning team review classified this as an organisational factor.

recommendations: Confirm at the next assurance activity that the guarding, clearance and misfire handling for a blast on P-8302 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in charging and firing, specifically clearing misfires and handling residue. P-8302 (reagent dosing pumps) is in service for reagent make-up and dosing. The task proceeded during a statutory inspection while the guarding, clearance and misfire handling for a blast was in place but did not perform. The chemical energy involved is held as hydrocarbon, and the recorded presentation was fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation.
response.summary: On 18 April 2026 a corrective action on P-8302 at Tolgarra Processing and Power Station was reviewed against the material unwanted event control it was raised to restore.
